enemies.name: Bellows Grub
enemies.signature: A light Fire breath gathers 5 Guard before Exhale strikes for 7 Fire, then 6 Wind in the same turn, followed by recovery.
enemies.counter: Prepare separate Fire and Wind defenses before Exhale; build while it recovers.
